eval_feedback: Baseline handled heavy delegation gracefully — the user answered '추천해주세요' on 3 of 4 axes and the run converted each into a labeled recommendation rather than burning a confirmation round, keeping the confirmed/delegated/assumed boundary crisp. It also surfaced a genuine edge case the brief never mentions (same order_id+line_no but differing content → report-only, never auto-delete), which is exactly the unknown-unknown instinct the rubric prizes. All 9 quality assertions pass; the only quality gap vs the skill arm is D4 (open prose vs hypothesis options). As with the other baseline runs, this eval's explicit CHANGELOG/README territory lets a careful agent resolve the destructive trap without the skill scaffold, so the arms separate mainly on the contract layer and question economy.
